cards.designer_desc: Design a fresh database architecture from scratch using our visual ERD tool. Code-to-canvas syncing is automatic.
cards.import_desc: Sync your existing PostgreSQL or MySQL structure via SQL scripts, DDL statements, or connection strings.
cards.explorer_desc: Run high-performance queries across your active nodes, browse content models, and edit mock documents in the Data Studio.

alerts.title: System Alerts
alerts.no_alerts: All systems operating normally. No active alerts.

settings.title: Workspace Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure local connection pooling, database credentials, query safety guards, and UI preferences.
settings.success_desc: Local database environment variables synchronized with cluster runtime buffers.

guards.title: Query Guards
guards.autocommit_desc: Automatically commit all statement changes upon successful query execution without requiring an explicit COMMIT statement.
guards.safe_desc: Reject any UPDATE or DELETE commands that do not have a targeting WHERE clause. Prevents accidental mass entity deletions.

reset.title: Restore Workspace defaults
reset.desc: Resets connection limits, layout splits, and cached mock schemas back to system initial values.

session.desc: This Studio instance is protected by a shared password. Signing out clears the current session and returns to the login screen.

login.description: This Studio instance requires a password to continue.
